evidence.title: Tabbied - Free generative patterns and website templates

name: Tabbied
summary: Generative pattern library: 382 customizable patterns, 437 palettes, 377 website templates and an npm package.
description: Patterns drawn in the browser with css-doodle and usable as page backgrounds: recolor from 437 palettes, adjust frequency and density, seed them, and export a 3000px PNG or vector SVG. The tabbied npm package ships the same designs with React, Vue, Svelte, web-component and plain HTML entry points plus a rendering CLI, and an MCP server lets assistants search and preview designs; 377 website templates are built on the same engine.
contains: npm package tabbied v0.9.0 (MIT) with React/Vue/Svelte/web-component/HTML entries
CLI renders SVG, PNG or frame sequences via Playwright
MCP server tabbied-mcp: searchdesigns, previewdesign, getdesign, listtemplates
patterns free for personal and commercial use; templates licensed per account; free and paid plans
